measurement_window_utc.note: Approximate to the minute; per-run wall timestamps were not captured. All three runs completed within this window.

source_transfer.method: scripts/agent_worktree.sh worktree from the canonical local repo, branch wt/t1c3090 checked out at the pin

provider.name: local (project devbox)
provider.note: No rental; run on the project's own machine. GPU idle before every attempt.

build.cuobjdump_note: CUDA 13.3 cuobjdump prints fatbin sections without cubin file names; both ELF sections are sm_86 and no PTX section is present.

benchmark.command_template: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 uv run --no-project --with 'numpy==2.5.1' --with 'torch==2.13.0' python blaze/env/verify_cuda.py --bench --t0 --n N --decisions 1000 --repeat 4 --warmup 10 --device 0
benchmark.selection_rule: Three independent full commands at N=2048; report the exact emitted row from the median run by decisions/s.

n2048_runs.raw: N=2048: 1.03M env-ticks/s  256273 decisions/s  (7.99s for 1000 decisions, 18/2048 done at end)
N=2048: 1.04M env-ticks/s  258864 decisions/s  (7.91s for 1000 decisions, 18/2048 done at end)
N=2048: 1.03M env-ticks/s  258722 decisions/s  (7.92s for 1000 decisions, 18/2048 done at end)

benchmark.spread_note: Run 1 launched from idle clocks (210 MHz SM preflight sample) and is the low outlier; runs 2 and 3 launched with clocks already boosted from the preceding run and agree within 0.055%. The median rule absorbs the cold first run.
benchmark.oom_note: Only N=2048 was attempted, per task scope. HEAD's batch-2048 region pool (21.5 GB plus fixed pools) is known not to fit 24 GB; the pin's 17.2 GB region pool fits, which is why the measurement runs at the pin.
benchmark.vram_free_reported_by_bench_gb: 25.0/25.3 (decimal GB as printed by the bench header, all three runs)
benchmark.isolation_note: nvidia-smi preceded every attempt: 21 MiB used, zero compute processes before all three runs. Machine is a single-user devbox; no other GPU workload ran during the window.

included: k_tick, k_obs, and k_final for each decision
cudaStreamSynchronize at the end of every blaze_step_full call
conditional host-driven masked resets for completed environments
excluded: action host-to-device copies because all 1000 action tensors were pre-generated on device before the timer

telemetry.prelaunch_caveat: Run 2 and run 3 samples retained boosted clocks and transient utilization from the just-exited prior process. They are not sustained timed-loop measurements.

setup.skip_reason: Java on gamer is OpenJDK 21, not JDK 8; the 13 generated Mojang-derived asset headers were copied into the worktree from the canonical tree by scripts/agent_worktree.sh, so no jar regeneration was needed. Java/oracle is not required for the throughput benchmark.

quick_sweep.note: setup_and_verify.sh --quick was not run; task scope was the throughput measurement only. Build, snapshot bake, and bench all completed at the pin.

deviations_from_t1_t2_protocol: Local devbox instead of a Vast.ai rental; no provider/rental/artifact-archive sections.
uv 0.11.3 instead of 0.12.1 (dependency pins numpy==2.5.1 / torch==2.13.0+cu130 identical).
nvcc 13.3.73 / driver 610.57.04 (CUDA 13.3) instead of nvcc 13.1.115 / driver 595.80.
OOM ladder (N=8192, N=16384) not attempted; N=2048 only per task scope.
